paragraphs.text: Skill manager for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): per-mode switches, search and tags, create/edit/import/ver
sion, install from GitHub
# Skill Manager (dsh-mode-skills)
English | 中文
A skill manager plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). It adds a **Skills** entry to the sidebar, below
**Plugins**: see every skill, turn it on or off per agent mode, create, edit, import, and version sk
ills, and install them from GitHub.
> A preview.
## What it does
- **Sidebar entry**: **Skills** sits beside **Plugins** and **Automation tasks**, outside Settings.
- **Every skill at a glance**: each skill shows its name, where it comes from (DSH user folder, shar
ed folder, project, bundled with a mode, from an installed package, GitHub, and so on), and its desc

ription. Expanded, it shows the file location, when to use it, and its state in every mode.
- **Per-
mode switches**: the list has a column for each mode that loads skills (up to four; with more, or on
a narrow window, each row says how many modes it is on in), with a switch per skill, so one click t
urns a skill on or off in a mode; a dash means the mode does not have that skill, and a **Manual** o
r **Model** setting shows as a label that expands the row. Expand a skill to set it **On**, **Manual
**, **Model**, or **Off** in each mode, or turn it on or off in all modes at once; choose a mode at
the top to get that mode's switch on every row, and **Turn all on** or **Turn all off** for the list
shown (Undo is offered). **Manual**: the model does not see the skill, but you can start it with `/
name`. **Model**: the model sees it, but the `/` menu does not offer it. A mode that does not load s

kills (such as Minimal) and a skill the mode does not have cannot be set, and the reason is shown.
-
**Search and organize**: search matches names, descriptions, display names, tags, and the text of t
he skill files (those matches are marked **Text match**). Give a skill a display name (such as a Chi
nese name) and tags, and filter by tag. Both are kept in this plugin's settings only; the skill file

is not changed.
- **Project skills**: **Project** takes a project folder (checked when you press Sh
ow, with the recent ones offered) and also lists the skills in its `.dsh/skills` and `.agents/skills
`. Switches apply to every project by name; a session loads a project skill only while it runs in th

at project.
[该节后续省略]
## When changes take effect
- In a mode that already has this plugin's settings, a change reaches running sessions from their ne

xt step.
- The first skill turned off, Manual, or Model in a mode adds a settings row to the mode, s
o that change reaches new sessions; the notice after saving names the mode.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Run `pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mode-skills` in the source folder if you run dsh from sou
rce, then restart `dsh web`. To try a checkout, use `link:/path/to/dsh-mode-skills` instead of the n
then restart `dsh web`. To try a checkout, use `link:/path/to/dsh-mode-skills` instead of the name.
Installing from GitHub needs to reach `codeload.github.com` from the machine that runs dsh. Behind a
proxy, set `HTTPS_PROXY` and `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1` before starting dsh.
## Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The row this plugin adds to a mode is saved with a condition that switches it off once the package i
s gone. After an uninstall every mode keeps working and the skills turned off come back in every mod
e. The `.dsh-mode-skills/` folder in the profile directory stays, so installing again brings the set
tings back. Delete it to clean up.
## Updates
The page checks for a newer version of this plugin and can install it.
- **Check**: when you open the page, the plugin asks the npm registry DSH is configured with (a mirr
or works) for the latest version of `dsh-mode-skills`, at most once every 12 hours. The request name
s only the package. Turn it off with **Check for updates automatically** at the bottom of the page;
**Check for plugin updates** there still works. Development installs (`link:`) are never checked. (T
he **Check for updates** button above the list is a different one: it checks the skills you installe

d from GitHub.)
- **Upgrade**: a banner at the top shows a newer release with **See what changed** a
nd **Upgrade…**. After you confirm, DSH's own installer downloads that release's tarball from the re
gistry and installs it, with progress and **Cancel install**. The installer restores the profile's f
iles when an install fails or is cancelled, and the banner then shows the installer's message and th
e command to upgrade by hand. Only the `latest` release is offered, never a prerelease, and the tarb

all address must be this package's file on the registry that answered.
- **After the upgrade**: depe
nding on the DSH version, the new version takes over at once (this page closes; open it again) or lo
ads when you restart dsh (web: run `dsh web` again; desktop app: quit and reopen). The next time you
open the page it says **Upgraded to** the new version. Your skills and settings stay, and running s

essions are not affected. The banner shows the command that goes back to the old version.
- **Instal
led from GitHub**: the banner shows `dsh plugin --profile web add github:xiaohai-78/dsh-mode-skills`

instead of a button.
- **By hand**: run `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mode-skills@latest`, or o
n the Plugins page use **Add plugin** with `https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-mode-skills/-/dsh-mode-sk
ills-<version>.tgz`. Without `@latest` the command does nothing, because DSH keeps the version it in

stalled.
- **From 0.2.0 or older**: those versions have no update check; upgrade them by hand once.
## Plan

1. **View only** (done): sidebar entry, every skill, its state in each mode.
2. **Per-mode switches*
* (done): work with only this plugin installed; modes keep working after an uninstall; saved through

Mode Manager when it is installed.
3. **Skill library** (done): create, edit, import from Codex, Cl
aude Code, or a folder, source change notices, version history; saved through Mode Manager when it i

s installed.
4. **Everyday gaps** (done): trash, checking and fixing skill files DSH skips, token co

sts, zip and folder uploads, more agent folders, per-mode Manual.
5. **Management and GitHub** (done
): Model-only, tags and display names, text search, project skills, bulk switches, the files of a sk
ill folder, export, DSH only or all agents, GitHub installs with update checks, handing Off settings

to Mode Manager.
[该节后续省略]
